data.name: Perfect Merger
data.description: Your suit cannot be dispelled or removed against your will.  You can spend two uses of your reconfigure ability to alter all the customizations on your astral suit.  Once per day, you can dismiss your suit to heal all of your hit points, but the suit cannot be reformed for 10 minutes afterwards.
